title: 防犯灯（ソーラー付き）
titleEn: Pole-mounted security light with solar panel
description: 住宅地の生活道路に立つ、ソーラーパネル付きのLED防犯灯です。フランジ付きの細い鋼管柱とナット、曲げパイプの腕、灯具と発光するLEDレンズ、電源ボックス、傾けた小型ソーラーパネルと枠・取付腕を造形しています。発光は材質の自発光のみで、照明器具としての配光、配線、管理番号の文字は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.340 × 3.365 × 1.079 m、2,604三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A solar-assisted LED security light for residential lanes. It models the slim flanged steel pole with nuts, a curved bracket arm, the luminaire with a lit LED lens, a driver box and a tilted small solar panel with frame and bracket. Illumination is an emissive material only; photometric light, wiring and asset-number lettering are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.340 × 3.365 × 1.079 m; 2,604 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
